_meta.mode: READ-ONLY (classification only; no text replacement proposed)
_meta.scan_scope: whole repo, excluding node_modules, target, .git, .next, dist, *.lock, package-lock.json, and artifacts/** (prior audit working files = meta-noise, not a repo surface)
_meta.counts_method: totals = matching-line count per term (rg -in | wc -l); ok = total - (len(suspect)+len(bad)); each line-item attributed to the single term literally present in its snippet to avoid double-counting across overlapping terms

classification.OK: current/correct usage: negation/boundary statements ('there is no CA', 'not a certificate', 'no admission function'), boundary blocklists in guards/BanzAI, the canonical L2 conformance-certification model (docs/governance/certification-boundary.md, ADR-038/039/040), Apache-2.0 software LICENSE, regulatory-boundary wording, historical/supersession governance + ADR docs, false-positive tokens
classification.SUSPECT: potentially ambiguous certification-vs-licence-vs-admission, BANZA-possessive naming, or residual field/route/asset names from the removed issued-certificate model still live even at zero-state; plus the M2.19F simulator-framing realignment target and the M2.19B legacy_trust_invariants (INV-TRUST-*) survival
classification.BAD: removed-CA / operator-financial framing present as a CURRENT (non-negated, non-historical) claim or a live runtime path

_meta.headline: Public/normative prose surfaces are boundary-clean: forbidden terms appear overwhelmingly as negations, blocklists, the canonical L2 conformance model, or supersession docs. The one clear BAD is a LIVE runtime path (verification-api /certificates) that SQL-selects issued operator certificates with issuer_key_id + certification_level (the removed model materialized in code). Dominant SUSPECT survivals: (1) legacy INV-TRUST-001..007 invariant IDs (313 occ; canonical model uses INV-OTE-*/INV-FEDEVAL-*, which now coexist) across contracts/invariants.json, spec/federation/*, and the public Reference = the M2.19B legacy_trust_invariants gate; (2) residual issued-certificate field/route naming (production_certificates, /certificates as 'canonical machine route', operator-certificate-lifecycle SVG, certification_level_achieved contract field); (3) Operador-Zero 'simulator/simulador' identity = M2.19F realignment target.

certificate.ok_rationale: Vast majority are negations ('not a production certificate', 'no operator certificates', 'evidence, not a certificate'), boundary blocklists, TLS/self-signed contexts, and supersession maps (deleted ADR-022/032).

license.ok_rationale: Apache-2.0 software LICENSE / SPDX headers (code) + regulatory-boundary negations ('no banking license'). No BANZA-licenses-operators framing found (positive hits are BanzAI boundary blocklists / eval questions answered NO).

licença.ok_rationale: Regulatory-boundary usage ('licenças e autorizações aplicáveis, que só as entidades competentes concedem', 'sob as suas próprias licenças', 'não representa ... licença') + BanzAI blocklists. Correct current wording.

authorisation.ok_rationale: Regulatory-boundary usage ('authorisation comes from the competent regulator, never from BANZA', 'not an authorisation', 'does not authorise operators') + technical auth (tokens/OAuth). No BANZA-as-regulator claim found.

autorização.ok_rationale: Regulatory-boundary usage + the scheme-operator REGULATORY_AUTHORIZATION_IN_PROGRESS state + negations ('não representa autorização', BANZA_REGULATORY_POSITIONING.md 'o BANZA autoriza operadores financeiros' is under the 'O que este documento NÃO afirma' heading). Correct.

approval.ok_rationale: Governance/PR/ADR approval + negations ('no approval step', 'humans do not authorise, accept, approve or certify operators'). No discretionary operator-admission approval asserted as current.

aprovação.ok_rationale: Governance approval + negations ('nenhum operador é aprovado ou certificado por decisão privada', 'nem processo de aprovação', 'humanos ... não aprovam operadores'). Correct.

admission.ok_rationale: Every occurrence on public/normative surfaces NEGATES admission ('there is no admission function in the protocol', 'is not an admission', 'não existe função de admissão', 'no admission to restore'). This is precisely the correct current model (ADR-038). Note: L3 scheme-operator-scheme 'admission' (a valid future concept) is not yet present on scanned surfaces.

BANZA operator.ok_rationale: 'a Banza operator' / 'BANZA operators' means an operator OF the Banza protocol (an implementer) — NOT BANZA-as-operator. Used correctly in RFCs/ADRs/spec/contracts ('every BANZA operator MUST expose ...', capability negotiation, conformance vector naming). Not the removed BANZA-as-operator financial framing.

certificate authority.ok_rationale: All occurrences are negations ('there is no certificate authority', SVG 'no certificate authority and no operator certificates'), enforcement guards (tools/check-*.sh detection patterns), supersession maps (ADR-057, deleted ADR-022/032), or historical governance/phase docs documenting the CA removal. No positive current CA claim.

root certificate.ok_rationale: No occurrences. The surviving primitive is 'Trust Root' (an offline threshold signing key), never a 'root certificate' — correctly absent.

CA.ok_rationale: \bCA\b hits are enforcement guards, negations ('no BANZA CA', 'Ausência de autoridade certificadora'), ADR/supersession docs (ADR-038 'open protocol trust model without CA', ADR-057), historical governance/phase docs, and non-CA false positives. No positive current 'BANZA CA' claim on live surfaces (verified: all BANZA CA / autoridade certificadora hits are negated or supersession).

Operador Zero.ok_rationale: Operador Zero as the reference/demo implementation (demo_only, KZ_DEMO, never in /operators as a real operator, PASS = local technical evidence not certification) is current/correct. Its 'simulator/simulador' IDENTITY (the M2.19F realignment target) is itemized under the 'simulator' term to avoid double-counting; the 'Operador Zero' name itself is OK.

sem acordos bilaterais.ok_rationale: Correct current description of OPEN federation — operators federate without bilateral agreements because they share the open protocol + Open Trust Evaluation over signed metadata/verifiable evidence. Not a certificate/admission substitute; it is the anti-gatekeeper property.

INV-TRUST-001..007 (NOT in prompt term l.ok_rationale: n/a — flagged as the M2.19B legacy_trust_invariants gate. Content is open-trust-aligned (signed metadata / delegated keys / revocation / self-published conformance evidence, NOT CA-issued-certificate framing), but the ID family is canonically superseded: INV-OTE-* (36 occ) and INV-FEDEVAL-* (29 occ) already coexist. Per task header INV-TRUST-001..007 are on the REMOVED list; their survival across contract + normative spec + public Reference is the largest realignment surface.
